decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated the options based on a combination of utility, user ratings, and overall popularity. Many products in the feed were accessories rather than actual backpacks. Among the backpacks, the Savior Equipment and DeMarini bags are highly rated but quite specialized. The NICGID sling bag is very popular but may be too small for versatile use. I ultimately chose the TOURIT Cooler Backpack because of its strong rating (4.6) from over 1,500 reviews and its dual-purpose design which makes it excellent for day trips, work, or beach outings. It offers a good balance of specialized function (insulated cooler) and standard backpack storage.
